title: Contract for a Finite Pass
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-tape machine, let $F: br	o C$ be a sequence of configurations, let $D$ be a configuration, and let $L$ be a natural number. Suppose each step from $F(r)$ is $F(r+1)$ for $r<L$, the step from $F(L)$ is $D$, and $D$ is fixed by a step. If predicates $P$ and $Q$ both hold at every $F(r)$ for $r\le L$, and $Q$ holds at $D$, then after $L+1$ steps from $F(0)$ the machine is at $D$; $P$ holds at every time $t<L+1$, and $Q$ holds at every time $t\le L+1$.
